profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DDOG, with CIK 0001561550, headquartered in New York, NY. Its website describes its offering as cloud monitoring as a service, presenting metrics from apps, tools and services in one place, and inviting visitors to try it for free.

The site also frames the company around security. It describes defending against AI-powered attacks and says that integrating security and observability lets organizations decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with what it calls agentic speed.

The company's law exposure is listed in New York, with a count of 368.
